name: CARE
summary: CARE USA (the Cooperative for Assistance and Relief Everywhere), the largest member of the CARE International confederation, runs emergency response and long-term development in more than 46 countries through its own country offices and local partners: food and cash in crises, water and hygiene, maternal and reproductive health, Village Savings and Loan Associations for women, farming and climate resilience, and girls' education, mostly in Sub-Saharan Africa and the Middle East. Modelled on CARE USA's audited accounts for the year to 30 June 2025.

spending.source: https://www.care.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/2025-CARE-Financial-Statements.pdf (Consolidated Financial Statements, year ended 30 June 2025, Ernst & Young: statement of activities p. 3, program activities $747,787 thousand of total expenses $834,838 thousand)

lines.label: Humanitarian response, development programmes and public information
lines.source: https://www.care.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/2025-CARE-Financial-Statements.pdf (statement of functional expenses p. 5, $ thousands, year to 30 June 2025): humanitarian 396,977, development 343,530, public information 7,280. One line because charityevals models the three accounts lines as branches of one portfolio model (relief; health, water, savings groups, food security and education; public information; Convention 4).
